data.title: PixVerse Kicks Off PixLight, a Global Competition for AI Filmmakers
data.description: Singapore-based company PixVerse has announced the launch of PixLight, an international competition aimed at filmmakers, screenwriters, and visual storytellers utilizing AI technology. The competition focuses on the quality of storytelling, emphasizing the development of compelling narratives with well-rounded characters and unique creative expression. Participants have the option to compete in two tracks: Pilot Track for creators prepared to submit a final film. The initiative encourages individuals to prioritize storytelling over showcasing AI capabilities.

data.title: Lomiko Metals Provides Update on Arrangement With Global Battery Materials, Loan Facility and Funding of the Yellow Fox Project
data.description: VANCOUVER, British Columbia - Lomiko Metals Inc. has garnered increased shareholder backing for its recent deal with Global Battery Materials Corp. The agreement stipulates that Global Battery Materials Corp. will purchase all of Lomiko's common shares for C$0.13 per share. The transaction involves a court-approved process and is expected to include the acquisition of all outstanding common shares of Lomiko Metals Inc. This transaction is facilitated through the Toronto Stock Exchange Venture (LMR), OTC Markets Group (LMRMF), and the Frankfurt Stock Exchange (DH8C).
